title: BC Friday Tips #48 Save Prompt File
summary: Business Central developers can save Copilot prompts in Visual Studio Code to reuse them repeatedly or share them with team members instead of retyping.
key_points: Save prompts in your VS Code workspace or user data folder for persistent reuse
Avoid retyping the same prompt by storing it once in your development environment
Share standardized prompts across teams for consistent assistance and knowledge transfer

quotes.text: Instead of retyping or asking the same question again and again, just store your prompt in your workspace or User Data folder.
quotes.why_it_matters: This technique eliminates repetitive work and enables teams to build a library of useful prompts for common tasks.

quotes.text: Stop retyping the same prompt in VS Code. Save it once, reuse it forever.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the core benefit of storing prompts for long-term productivity gains and knowledge retention.
